key_insight: An H₂-optimal design framework identifies riblet wall-normal profiles that maximize modeled turbulence attenuation at a fixed spanwise spacing.
engineering_relevance: Systematic riblet-shape optimization could reduce reliance on exhaustive geometry sweeps when designing drag-reducing channel surfaces.
method: Model riblets through volume penalization in linearized Navier–Stokes dynamics.
Recast penalization as a structured state-feedback operator.
Minimize steady-state velocity-fluctuation variance and riblet-induced dynamical augmentations at constant bulk flux.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports optimized profiles for fixed riblet spacing but provides no quantitative attenuation, drag-reduction, or validation results.
watch_item: Optimality is tied to the linearized model and fixed spacing; practical drag-reduction gains require independent validation.
paper_title: $H_2$-optimal riblet profiles for turbulence suppression in channel flows
